facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Commission's notice of 26 June 2026 applies section 32 of the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023, which requires controllers of major importance to designate a Data Protection Officer.
The notice is issued under Schedule 3 of the General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2025, made under the Nigeria Data Protection Act.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is acting under the Act: it issued the notice, verifies DPOs against its database and will set up a digital system to monitor their CPD.
The Commission issued guidance on Data Protection Officer assessment and annual CPD points, with temporary inactive status for non-compliance, and no decision against a controller is stated.
